summary.text: Humble Reciprocation is Fairy Ming Hao's human path killer move. With humility Gu as the core, it uses information recorded on Book Mountain to deduce and unleash killer moves that opponents have just used.

claims.text: When Fang Yuan’s subordinates press Sacred Mountain, Fairy Ming Hao resonates with the peak behind her; the mountain of black lines and white paper shoots profound lights loaded with countless killer moves and deals with their attacks. Ice Crystal Immortal Monarch and Xiao He Jian take it as a secluded domain of heaven and earth, and she casually names the method while treating each returned strike as a present. She fires it again and stops their offenses alone until Lu Wei Yin arrives with muddy yellowish light to stabilize them.

At the peak of Book Mountain she uses the human path killer move Humble Reciprocation again; Book Mountain shakes and unleashes countless killer moves like fireworks while Primordial Domain tribulations rumble overhead.

She keeps using Book Mountain to fire the move and, with that pressure, suppresses Fang Yuan’s forces and Longevity Heaven. The released attacks are all recorded in Book Mountain: the killer move is human path in essence, but the power of each attack stays on its original path. At the peak she maintains Humble Reciprocation while Heavenly Court’s defensive line wavers under Immortal Gu House pressure.

While Zhan Bu Du fights on the mountain, he must also resist Fairy Ming Hao’s Humble Reciprocation as he regains footing. Calamity Luck Altar then bursts with golden light that surrounds Book Mountain, turns tribulations against the peak, and shakes the mountain itself. Fairy Ming Hao turns pale and names Giant Sun Immortal Venerable as the one who countered Humble Reciprocation after it was only used for a second time; she withdraws the killer move rather than lose her life. She recalls that the same move had already stopped Fang Yuan and Lu Wei Yin when they first led an army against Book Mountain in Yellow Earth Great World.
After the withdrawal, Humble Reciprocation is broken, even though three pseudo venerables still hold the peak.

Star Constellation Immortal Venerable activates the immortal killer move Humble Reciprocation with a small phantom image of Book Mountain on her left palm; thousands of killer moves pour out, each targeting its original owner, and Immortal Zombie Giant Sun is among those hit. The move only returns other Gu Immortals’ attacks at power that does not cross Limitless’ bottom line, forcing owners to defend and stabilizing Heavenly Court without using stronger methods that would trigger Limitless’ countermeasures. Fang Yuan’s killer moves cannot be returned this way because they are compound killer moves that only his sovereign physique can use, so she has to pin him down herself. Humble Reciprocation burdens the mind and consumes too many thoughts, and even Star Constellation Immortal Venerable feels that burden.

Known users.text: Fairy Ming Hao (creator) Star Constellation Immortal Venerable
